claims.assertion: Mari describes time as a sequence of thought and a timeline as events experienced by an individual or group; it cannot be moved independently of their changing perception and intentions.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says ships use numerical mass-energy-frequency maps and toroidal plasma fields to match a destination’s pattern, enabling space-time travel without treating distance or dates as physical spans.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari’s account of the navigation method.
